skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the LCD of two unlike denominators and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Numerator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions (or fractional parts of mixed numbers) that already share a common denominator.

skills.name: Whole/fraction decomposition
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number (or treat a whole number as integer + 0/d) into whole and fractional parts and subtract the whole-number parts independently.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction yields a negative result, regroup one whole unit from the minuend's whole part as d/d added to the fraction part, then re-subtract (repeating if still negative).

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.
